description: Sharpness-aware (SAM) training of a batched deep ensemble (K=4) of the incumbent V4-exact relational transformer (recipe change vs r06_recipe_ens4wd: SAM, per-member radius rho = 0.1). Member = incumbent r05: 1 global (h, p) token + 4 resonator tokens from ellipse shape-tensor invariants s = rx+ry, u, v = (rx-ry)cos/sin 2theta, |d|, u/|d|, v/|d|, h, p (shared GELU-MLP embedding), n_layers pre-LN blocks (d_model, 8 heads, GELU FFN 4x) with per-head attention-logit biases per resonator relation i XOR j (exact V4 invariance), mean pool, head concat(global, mean resonator) -> 2x Linear-GELU(head_w
